subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should Matrix polls with more than 20 options be silently truncated to the first 20 choices, or should OpenClaw reject them with a sender-visible validation error?
rationale: MSC3381 establishes the maximum, but it does not itself choose OpenClaw’s compatibility behavior for existing callers that supplied more choices.

options.title: Accept builder-level truncation
options.body: Keep this PR’s behavior so oversized calls still emit a spec-valid Matrix poll containing the first 20 options.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Require a narrow follow-up that surfaces an explicit validation error instead of silently dropping trailing choices.

recommendation.title: Accept builder-level truncation
recommendation.body: Keep this PR’s behavior so oversized calls still emit a spec-valid Matrix poll containing the first 20 options.
